text: cellxgene_db optional 'cellxgene_db' object, returned db(). tbl tibble() typically derived datasets(db) files(db) containing columns dataset_id (datasets_visualize()), columns dataset_id, file_id, filetype (files_download()). dry.run logical(1) indicating whether (often large) file(s) tbl downloaded local cache. Files downloaded dry.run = TRUE (default). cache.path character(1) directory cache downloaded files. directory must already exist. default tools::R_user_dir("cellxgenedp", "cache"), package-specific path user home directory.

title: Query cellxgene collections, datasets, and files — collections
text: function returns tibble describing corresponding component database. files_download() returns character() vector paths local files. links() returns tibble external links associated collection. Common links includ DOI, raw data / data sources, lab websites. authors() returns tibble authors associated collection. publisher_metadata() returns tibble publisher metadata (journal, publicate date, doi) associated collection.
